title: BMS master board — Teensy A + B, 6× SN65HVD230, 5 V buck, LEM dividers, throttle clamp, LM339 plug + release detect, MCP23017 footprint (LATER)
notes: PROPOSED (Gilfoyle 2026-10-23, Build 21; Build 24 applies chief + Sparky 06:57 DECIDED answers). Generated by tools/boards/gen_bms_master.py from docs/PINMAP.yaml + docs/THROTTLE_CLAMP.md; every net desc cites its PINMAP wire id. Edit in tools/perfboard.html, Export JSON, commit here.
Board 70×82 holes = 177.8 × 208.3 mm (7.0 × 8.2 in) incl. a 2-hole margin; M3 mounts at the four corners.

GROUND: ONE signal-ground star BAR (18 AWG bare, bottom side) BC20–BC40; star holes BC20, BC22, BC24, BC26, BC28, BC30, BC32, BC34, BC36, BC38, BC40. Each ground group (power/buck, CAN A, CAN B, Teensy A, Teensy B, clamp, analog) lands on ONE star hole and touches no other group — same single-point rule as coil_driver's V22 star (PINMAP S49). LEM A (J-LEMA.2, G09), LEM B (J-LEMB.2, G10), pedal (J-THR.2, G11) and Kelly RTN (J-KEL.2, G12) each have their OWN star hole — separate wires, no daisy-chain (DECIDED Sparky 06:57 #4). J-PWR.2 is the board star's ONE link to TB-GND (G03; TB-GND = LV star with G07 and coil_driver G08, chief 06:57 #5). Teensy A signal ground leaves only on J-DRV.1 -> coil_driver J-SIG.1 (DECIDED room 06:11; G04 dropped).

Zones: CAN + buck on the left/right/top edges; analog (LEM/pedal dividers, LM339, PROX) bottom-right, kept ≥8 holes (20 mm) from any SN65 module, CAN terminator, fuse or the buck (see test_perfboard).

Teensy A/B: VIN/VUSB pad CUT on both (P11/P12) — they run from the board 5 V bus. SN65HVD230 modules: wire by SILKSCREEN (pin order varies by vendor; the footprint order here is a placeholder). Keep the onboard 120 Ω (usually R2 marked 121) only on a module at a physical bus end; remove it elsewhere. Check powered off: CANH-CANL ≈60 Ω (DECIDED Sparky 06:57 #2).

Top = insulated solid-core jumpers (may pass under the Teensy/SN65 headers); bottom = wire on the solder side. Soldered at every vertex. Wire gauges: 20 AWG power/ground, 22 AWG signal, 18 AWG star bar.

LM339 (DECIDED chief 06:57 #1): ch1 OUT1 pin 2 -> A:33, ch2 OUT2 pin 1 -> B:33 (plug, 2.5 V ref); ch3 OUT3 pin 14 -> 1k -> A:2, ch4 OUT4 pin 13 -> 1k -> B:35 (release, 1.40 V ref = 10k/3.9k); each output has its own 10k pull-up to its board 3.3 V + 100 nF; VCC pin 3, GND pin 12. No hysteresis resistors: 100 nF + 20 ms firmware debounce (Sparky 06:57 #1/#3). Firmware must set A:2 INPUT (boots as output) — later commit, no flashing. J-REL removed (Build 24).
MCP23017 U6 is LATER: footprint only, not fitted (chief 06:57 #3). When fitted: 0x20 (A0-A2 to GND), 4.7k SDA/SCL pull-ups to 3.3 V, RESET high through 10k RRST.
BMS_CAP 0 / TELEMETRY_ONLY 1 — this board does not change any limit; firmware is not flashed (no flashing).

GND.desc: ONE signal ground, single STAR BAR (18 AWG, bottom side). Each ground group (power/buck, CAN A, CAN B, Teensy A + ESP + coil_driver SGND + expander, Teensy B, clamp, analog, and separately LEM A G09, LEM B G10, pedal G11, Kelly RTN G12 — Sparky 06:57 #4, no daisy-chain) joins the bar by ONE wire and nowhere else (S49 'single-point ground'; same rule as coil_driver's V22 star). J-PWR.2 is the board's only ground lead to TB-GND (G03; exactly one link, chief 06:57 #5). Teensy A signal ground leaves on J-DRV.1 -> coil_driver J-SIG.1 (DECIDED room 2026-10-23 06:11, G04: no Teensy GND wire at TB-GND).

offboard.short: ESP32 is OFF-BOARD: J-ESP 1 = A:17 TX, 2 = GND, 3 = +5 V
offboard.text: ESP32 telemetry module is NOT on this board. J-ESP.1 = Teensy A:17 Serial4 TX -> ESP32 GPIO16 RX (S30, TX-only link); J-ESP.2 = GND (G05, from the Teensy A ground group); J-ESP.3 = +5 V board bus (P08). TELEMETRY_ONLY 1.
